title: IndoAgri-DB: Automated Agriculture Dataset for India
description: IndoAgri-DB is an automated, periodically updated agriculture database for India. It integrates publicly available agricultural data from multiple sources covering administrative districts, weather, soil health, mandi prices, disaster alerts, government schemes, farmer queries, and crop advisories. The repository provides processed and structured datasets intended to support agricultural information systems, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications.
